title: Perverse subcategories of the first kind
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ in which $\ell$ is invertible, and an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$. Work in the bounded constructible coefficient category $\mathcal C_X=D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], with its integer shifts $[n]$. For $K\in\mathcal C_X$, let $\operatorname{SuppCon}(K)$ and $\operatorname{CosuppCon}(K)$ be the support and cosupport conditions of [def-per-support-condition], with empty support of dimension $-\infty$. Define the following full subcategories of $\mathcal C_X$ (their morphisms are all ambient morphisms between the specified objects):

$$
\begin{aligned}
{}^pD^{\le0}(X)&:=\bigl\{K:\ \operatorname{SuppCon}(K)\bigr\},\\
{}^pD^{\ge0}(X)&:=\bigl\{K:\ \operatorname{CosuppCon}(K)\bigr\},
\end{aligned}
$$

and, for every $n\in\mathbf Z$,

$$
{}^pD^{\le n}(X):={}^pD^{\le0}(X)[-n],\qquad
{}^pD^{\ge n}(X):={}^pD^{\ge0}(X)[-n].
$$

The *perverse heart candidate* is

$$
\mathrm{Perv}^{\mathrm{cand}}(X):={}^pD^{\le0}(X)\cap{}^pD^{\ge0}(X).
$$

split_report.summary: Definition-only split, with unchanged defining formulas and statement dependencies; the inherited coefficient and scheme context is now explicit. Read both current main-20261015 and master blueprint definitions, the unit and chapter, and both dependency statements. The support/cosupport predicates are exactly def-per-support-condition; def-weil-pbc-qbar-category supplies the ambient bounded constructible category and its integer shift through its explicitly named common-stage shift construction. The heart candidate is only the conjunction of the two degree-zero conditions. No t-structure, abelian-heart, or duality theorem is asserted here. Searches of the whole imported blueprint, DAG, project Lean, and Mathlib found no alternative exact definition to attach. Tagged upstream predicates are on an ordinary derived category of etale sheaves rather than the intrinsic adic coefficient category. No new nodes were necessary. reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q62-5ff1f3cbc (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS. Every defining formula is verbatim from main-20261015 and master (the bodies are identical; only the order differs). The formulas are pD^{≤0}={SuppCon}, pD^{≥0}={CosuppCon}, pD^{≤n}=pD^{≤0}[−n], pD^{≥n}=pD^{≥0}[−n] for all n, and Perv^cand = pD^{≤0} ∩ pD^{≥0}. The stmt_deps are unchanged: def-per-support-condition and def-weil-pbc-qbar-category. The only change replaces 'In the setting of' (a B2 fault) with explicit context: ℓ prime, ℓ invertible in k, a chosen Q̄_ℓ, X separated of finite type over k, D^b_c(X,Q̄_ℓ) with its shifts, and the empty-support convention. This is what the two dependencies already require: the Q̄_ℓ category needs a noetherian finite-dimensional base with ℓ invertible, and the dualizing complex needs the ℓ-invertible conventions. No citer is broken; all of them work with ℓ invertible in k or over F_q with ℓ≠p. The shift directions agree with lem-per-qbar-middle-tstructure: K∈pD^{≤n} ⇔ dim Supp H^jK ≤ n−j, and K∈pD^{≥n} ⇔ DK∈pD^{≤−n}. Small cases check out: Q̄_ℓ[0] on a point is in the heart; Q̄_ℓ[1] on a point is in pD^{≤−1} but not pD^{≥0}; Q̄_ℓ[1] on A^1 is perverse; 0 and ∅ fall under the −∞ convention. There are no new nodes and no proof. The searches cover all three kinds. The upstream IsPerverseLE/GE/HeartCandidate (slopmaster2 Perverse/Basic.lean) lives on DerivedCategory(Sheaf X_et A), so refusing to attach it is correct. The item is not on the drop list and has no repair note. Advisory: separated/finite type, Q_ℓ and Q̄_ℓ are cited only through the stmt_deps.
